title: Sourcing End to End
description: Get sourcing working end to end. Reported blocker: `bun run dev:sourcing` exits with status 1 (nx run @semio-tech/framework-os-dev:dev -- sourcing). Diagnose and fix the launch path, then verify the sourcing app (curate document: Pool/Curated/Preview, beams/windows/slabs modules) actually boots and works interactively in the s product dev target (port 6081): artifact builds, editor/viewer render, commands, io and mutations round-trip through the pipeline.
summary: Sourcing runs end to end on :6081: boot, curation, drag, filters, sort, undo, 3D grid, Preview selection, example switch and saved-archive reload. The composed kit catalogue child is now derived where the parent is loaded — a new ArtifactApp::genesis_child_pack hook seeds it at boot through open_child and completes any archive that omits it before the member roster is reserved, minted from bytes via genesis_member_envelope_pack; non-flow s.stdio.semio members open through the new PackMemberSnapshotOpen instead of rejecting Decode; and PollDocumentArchiveLoad drives the maintenance rotation under a 4 ms wall budget, taking a whole-document load from 97 s to ~300 ms in the browser. Sourcing editor/viewer run over SemioMembers. Verified by 128 passing sourcing tests (the archive-door example load and a saved-archive reload among them), a store round-trip test for the genesis envelope, and a live browser pass with no faults.
